[P2] Match replay checkpoints by operation identity during enrichment

`replay.before` and `replay.after` are missing from this identity map. If context observations contain a completed checkpoint and collection adds previously absent metadata such as `endedAtMs`, `_retain_observations` treats the enriched row as a different record and appends the original. Even when collected before/after/history records agree and pass the standard validator, retention introduces duplicate checkpoint IDs and reports `INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE`, potentially quarantining the target. Match these inventories by operation `id`, preserving completed outcomes atomically while allowing missing metadata to be filled, and add a coordinator regression for this enrichment.
